g.text: Lorenz-96, 40 sites, F = 8, RK4; 0.05 time units taken as 6 h. Emulator: 9-point stencil -> 48 -> 48 -> 1 tanh MLP
shared by all sites, trained (Adam) on 3 000 days of 6-hourly states to predict the 6-h change; applied
autoregressively. 200 test forecasts from initial states with error sigma = 0.2.
